paite: Huan huai thil khit in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta kumpipa uain pepa leh atanghou bawlpa'n apu uh Aigupta kumpipa alungkimsak kei uhi.
heading: Joseph In Hentate Mang Aletkhia
english: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

paite: Pharaoh, asikha heutu nihte tung ah, a-uain pia heutupen tung ah leh atanghou bawl heutupen tung ah ahehta hi.
english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

paite: Huchi in vengmi pawl heutu inn, Joseph hen a a-omna suangkul ah, atangsakta hi.
english: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

paite: Vengmi pawl heutu in amau Joseph akemsak a, amau a-nna asepsak ua, bang tan hiamtak atang uhi.
english: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

paite: Suangkul a hen a om, Aigupta kumpipa uain pepa leh tanghou bawlpa'n zan khat khiakna tuam tuak mang anei uhi.
english: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

paite: Azing in akiang uah Joseph ava lut a, amau ava mu a, ngai in, ana lungkham mahmah uhi.
english: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

paite: Ama'n, "Bangchi na hi ua, tuni in lungkham mel pu na tel uchia?" chi in Pharaoh sikha heutu suangkul a tangte adong hi.
english: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Mang ka nei tuak ua, hon hilhchiansak thei kuamah lah a-om ngal kei a ahi," achi uh. Joseph in akiang uah, "Mang hilhchetnate Pathian a ahi kei maw? Hehpih in na mang uh hon hilh un," achi hi.
english: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”

paite: Huchi in uain pia heutupen in amang Joseph ahilh a, akiang ah, "Ngai dih, ka mang in, ka ma ah grepgui ahong om hi.
english: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

paite: Grepgui ah kahiang thum a-om a, ahong selnou ua, ahong pak ua, apakbomte'n grep minte ahon piangsak uhi.
english: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

paite: Huan ka khut ah Pharaoh nou ahong om a; grep gahte ka lou a, Pharaoh nou sung ah ka suk a, huai nou Pharaoh khut ah ka na pia,” achi hi.
english: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

paite: Joseph in akiang ah, ahilhchetna hiai ahi: "Kahiang thumte ni thum ahi.
english: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

paite: Tu a kipan ni thum in Pharaoh in na lutang adomkang ding a, na nasep mah ahon semsak nawn ding. A-uain pepa na hih lai a, na piak ngeina bang in akhut ah Pharaoh nou na pe nawn ding.
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

paite: Himahleh na dinmun ahong hoih hun chiang in hon theigige inla, hehpih in hehpihna ka tung a langsak in, Pharaoh kiang ah ka tungtang hon gen inla, huan hiai inn a kipan hon pikhia in.
english: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

paite: Hebrute gam a kipan mi'n aguk a, ahon gukmang uh ka hi a; hiai gam ah leng kokhuk sung a ahon khumna ding in bangmah ka hihkhial kei," achi hi.
english: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”

paite: Tanghou bawlpa'n hilhchetna ahoih chih atheih in, Joseph kiang ah, "Ke'n leng mang ka nei a, ngai in, lohbeu thum ka lu in ka na pua hi.
english: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

paite: Lohbeu tungnungpen ah Pharaoh an, tanghou bawlpa bawl, chi chih ana om hi. Huaite vasate'n lohbeu ka lu a ka puak a kipan ana ne souhsouh uh," achi hi.
english: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”

paite: Joseph in adawng a, “Hiai ahilhchetna ahi: Lohbeu thum ni thum ahi.
english: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

paite: Tu a kipan ni thum in Pharaoh in na pumpi a kipan na lutang adomkang ding a, sing dawn ah akhai ding. Huchi in vasate'n na sa ane souhsouh ding uh," achi hi.
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni, Pharaoh pian champha ni in, ama'n asikha tengteng a ding in ankuang alui hi. Asikhate lak a uain pia heutupen lutang adomkangta hi.
english: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

paite: Uain pia heutupen uain pemi mah in apangsak nawn a; Pharaoh khut ah nou apeta hi.
english: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;

paite: Himahleh Joseph in amau ahilhchet bangtak in, tanghou bawl heutupen akhailumta hi.
english: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

paite: Himahleh, uain pia heutupen in Joseph atheigige kei a, amangngilhta hi.
english: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.
